definitions.explanation: The skill or activity of making, repairing, or decorating things with a needle and thread.

examples.japanese: {母|はは}は{裁縫|さいほう}が{得意|とくい}だ。
examples.english: My mother is good at sewing.

examples.japanese: {学校|がっこう}で{裁縫|さいほう}を{習|なら}った。
{裁縫|さいほう}{道具|どうぐ}を{貸|か}してください。
examples.english: Please lend me your sewing tools.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{裁縫|さいほう}をする (to sew)
・{裁縫|さいほう}{道具|どうぐ} (sewing tools)
・{裁縫|さいほう}{箱|ばこ} (sewing box)
・{裁縫|さいほう}が{得意|とくい} (to be good at sewing)

EDUCATIONAL NOTE: Traditionally taught in home economics ({家庭科|かていか}) classes in Japanese schools.
